explanation: EXCLURAD computed the radiative corrections for η electroproduction at the specified kinematics (W=1.5576 GeV, Q²=0.5552 GeV², cos θ*=0.651724, φ*=72°) using full O(α) corrections with CLAS12 settings (beam 6.53 GeV, vcut=0.166 GeV²). The code handles 2 polarization states (transverse and longitudinal photon contributions). Values reported: delta = σ_obs/σ_born = (sigar(1)+sigar(2))/(sibar(1)+sibar(2)) = 0.005807/0.006343; sigma_born = 0.006343 (sum of both polarization states, in microbarns). Cross sections are dimensionless ratios in the code's internal units. delta < 1 indicates suppression of the observed cross section relative to Born prediction due to QED radiative effects.
